scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Integral and fractional expectation thresholds are equivalent” (preprints/Integral-and-fractional-expectation-thresholds-are-equivalent-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 175 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0c02b128253cb6e0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every finite nonempty X and every nonempty proper increasing family F ⊆ 2X, qf (F) ≤ 25 · 5124 q(F). Both thresholds use the budget 1/2. The constant is independent of |X|, the sizes of the minimal members of F, and the support of the fractional cover.
